 8VIETNAM OUTLOOK
Key Targets and Pillars for 2030
•GDP Growth: Target an average annual GDP growth rate of 10% or more in the 2026 -2030 period
•GDP Per Capita: Aim to reach US$8,500 per capita by 2030.
Global Ranking: Strive to be among the top 30 -35 largest economies in the world and the third largest in ASEAN by 2030.
•Digital Economy: Target the digital economy to account for 30% of GDP .
•Green  Growth : Achieve  green  growth  and  a carbon -neutral  economy,  striving  for a 15% reduction  in greenhouse  gas 
emission  intensity  per unit  of GDP  by 2030  compared  to2014 .
•Renewable Energy : Aim  for 15-20% contribution  of renewable  energy tothe total  primary  energy  supply  by2030
Changing on FDI attractive strategy
Manufacturing  status
Manufacturing  remains  the leading  growth  driver,  demonstrating  significant  resilience  amid  external  pressures
•Industrial  Production  Index  (IIP)  grew  robustly,  with  Manufacturing  and  Processing  expanding  by 9.2% in2025 .
•The  year  2025  marked  a significant  milestone  for Vietnam's  investment  landscape,  characterized  by resilience , in which  
final  result  reached  $38.42 billion , maintaining  a steady  growth  (+0.5% YoY)  despite  global  economic  fluctuations ..In 2025 , Vietnam’s  economy  achieved  a breakthrough  $514 B GDP  scale  and  8.02% growth,  synergized  by a historic  
administrative  restructuring  that  optimized  regional  economic  spaces  and  maintained  as attractive  destination  in the region  with  
FDI investors
•Vietnam  is making  a strategic  shift  in its Foreign  Direct  Investment  (FDI)  attraction  policy,  moving  away  from  relying  heavily  
on geographical  location  (i.e., less -developed  regions,  industrial  parks)  to determine  tax incentives . The  new  strategy  
focuses  on the quality,  sector,  and  scale  of the investment  project  itself .
•The  key change  is Vietnam's  move  to a selective  FDI attraction  policy,  with  incentives  now  primarily  tied  to industry  and  
technology  to drive  high -value,  sustainable  growth
